title: Findings of the rule check on tracks and vias
how: Rules: track width 0.15 mm, clearance 0.2 mm, via diameter 0.5 mm, drill 0.2 mm, annular ring 0.1 mm.
Tracks: 0.25 mm on A, 0.25 mm on B and 0.1 mm on A: only the last is under 0.15 mm = 1 finding PHOENIX-RULE-002.
Vias: the first (0.6 / 0.3 mm) passes all three rules; the second (0.4 / 0.15 mm) has a diameter under 0.5 mm and a drill under 0.2 mm = 2 findings PHOENIX-RULE-003;
its ring is (0.4 - 0.15) / 2 = 0.125 mm on each side, at least 0.1 mm, so no ring finding.
Clearance: A and B run in parallel 0.4 mm apart (centre to centre) with widths 0.25 and 0.25: the edges are 0.4 - 0.25 = 0.15 mm apart, under 0.2 mm = 1 finding PHOENIX-RULE-005;
the third track is 4.6 mm away from B, and no via is near a track of another net. 4 findings proven, none that could not be judged.
